constraints: Gates must stay hermetic (no live DB, no env values printed) like the existing scripts/tests. CI gates are repo-root .github/workflows and scripts/ owned by no plane, so naming Support Plane as owner is wrong (Support Plane is the RustDesk hbbs/hbbr backend per CLAUDE.md). approachAdjustment: Split into three. (1) Payload keys: ChatEvent::payload() is hand-built json!, so a ts-rs/schemars derive does not apply; either extend gen-sse-event-taxonomy.py to extract per-event field lists from the payload() arms and compare with chat-client.ts reads, or first convert payloads to serde structs, and add the unknown-key validator only in tests. (2) Hermetic syntactic gates modelled on scripts/tests with a self-test proving they fail: cross-plane DB scan first, log-content rule second. (3) Size ratchet last, baselined by hash like auth-core lint-ratchet; reading the level from the base branch needs a fetch step the current workflows do not have. Also verify buf.yml: it passes the unquoted path "apps/Model Plane/proto" (contains a space) to buf, so the job may not be checking what it appears to check (INF).
effortNote: Unchanged as a bundle, but the first slice (payload-key check extending the existing SSE gate) is S to M because the name-level gate, the parser and the CI wiring already exist.
verdictReason: Half of the stated benefit (backend event silently dropped by the SPA) is already guarded at event-name level; the item should say so, drop the derive approach that does not fit hand-built payloads, and fix the owner. The cross-plane DB, log and size gates are genuinely absent.

constraints: The pipeline runs in-process inside one SSE connection with a wall clock and dies with the stream (deep_research.rs header: deliberately not Temporal; queued_input is in-memory single-replica), so an approve-before-run gate cannot wait inside the stream. A research plan approval is not an authority grant: do not reuse PlanProposed rung-grant semantics, only the editable-list UI. Knowledge and connector sources must go through the existing viewer-ACL retrieval path and respect retrieval_scope (auto, knowledge_only, web_only) and Space authority. ZDR and waived-route turns refuse deep research, so the ledger and any plan record are never persisted for them.
approachAdjustment: Do not refactor one plan/run state machine inside the stream. Ship three independent slices: (1) a plan turn that returns the sub-query list (and at most one clarifying question) as an editable node, then a run turn that carries the edited list and is re-clamped server-side to the 9/10 ceilings; (2) an in-process second pass driven by coverage_of (unread and shortfall are already computed) with one extra search round inside the existing wall clock and page caps, adding a claim ledger only if the synthesis prompt is changed to extract claims (extra inference cost); (3) knowledge and connector sources by calling existing retrieval inside the pipeline under scope rules. Demote mid-run steering: queued_input is delivered only at tool-round boundaries (tool_loop.rs) and deep research is not a tool loop.
effortNote: Raised from L: the bundle is three separate M to L slices (plan turn, second pass with ledger, knowledge sources) plus steering; as independent items each is M or L.
verdictReason: The baseline is partly richer than described (plan checklist, early Kilder, user-linked URLs) and the proposed state machine does not fit an in-stream, single-replica pipeline; the item should be split and steering demoted.

verdictReason: Confirmed code gap: the OpenAI-family path (including the gpt-5-nano and gpt-5-mini defaults for Budget and simple Balance in intent.rs) ignores the user effort choice; the fix is small and well understood.

exactGap: No Goal record, budget accounting, completion judge or continuation driver exists. The nearest primitives are an in-memory TeamWorker (objective, context, success_criteria, no budget or judge) in coordinator.rs, a run's plain goal string, deterministic postcondition verifiers for effects, and the scheduled-step lane, which is one tool-less, 1,024-token, tool_choice none inference per step (execution-core grpc.rs:498-523) and so cannot continue a Do run. A run ends when its rounds end (DEFAULT_MAX_ROUNDS 12) and its credentials lapse at the delegated bearer lifetime.
reuse: ScheduledRunSupervision and the per-fire Control authorization pattern (reauthorizeScheduleFire, AuthorizeScheduledStep) as the model for per-continuation authority

constraints: Each continuation is unattended work, so it needs fresh Control-owned authorization; the only unattended lane today (model.schedule.step) is tool-less single-step and the workflow is marked DeniesZDR, and an unattended governed Do-run lane does not exist (plan D10 is an L, OD8 is the credential decision). A durable Goal row persists content, so ZDR threads must be refused (the item omits ZDR). Go workflow step responses carry no usage (the AutoresearchWorkflow exclusion in workflowreg.go says so), so token budget must come from cost-core run usage, and on the Subscription route nothing is metered so a token budget is a no-op. Never auto-continue across approval-required effects (ScheduledRunSupervision already fails on NeedsApproval). The judge call must inherit the turn privacy-tier floor.
approachAdjustment: Do not describe the driver as starting Do runs on "the same start path as scheduled runs": that lane executes one tool-less inference. Reframe as (1) a Goal record and budget ledger in session-core, non-ZDR only; (2) a continuation workflow modelled on ScheduledRunSupervision that obtains fresh Control authorization per continuation and starts a governed RunAgent, which requires the unattended Do-run lane (D10 and OD8) first; (3) a judge that prefers the proof bundle and postcondition results and falls back to a rubric judge through inference-core. A smaller attended first slice is possible: a goal bar in the Agent Run Console that auto-continues while the user session still holds delegated authority, with no new credential class.
effortNote: Raised from L: new durable record, a new unattended governed-run authority lane across Control and Model Plane, a judge, budget accounting from cost-core and the UI. L only for the attended first slice.
verdictReason: The gap is real and fully absent, but the premise that the scheduled lane can start budgeted Do runs is wrong and ZDR is missing from the constraints, so approach, dependencies and effort must change before it is planned.
